verdict.rationale: HashiCorp documents an official Terraform MCP server at a first-party URL, confirmed by the probe. It gives AI models real-time access to Terraform Registry provider docs, modules and policies. It also exposes workspace operations: create, update and delete workspaces, with variables, tags and run management. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting through it, and evidence of setup or connection instructions for specific agent clients.
